input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 所以他们找到了很多植物对药：来做药
- 神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears；吃了很多植物，了completed
- 但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人：他们吃的植物让他们生病，让Sb. + V./Adj.
- 神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒：可能毒性特别强，”特别是+N, + Clause” is used to single out a typical example
- 所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药：找一个可以做药的植物；这样，他们可以……
- 他想把花放在茶里，对药：做成药

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 很多植物对药：很多能做药的植物，The phrase “对药” cannot mean “able to be made into medicine”; “能做药的” correctly modifies the plants. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他们吃很多植物对药：他们把很多植物当药吃，“对药” cannot follow “吃” to express using something as medicine; this structure clearly states that they ate the plants as medicine. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他们的吃的植物：他们吃的植物，When the person who performs the action is inside a relative clause, place that subject directly before the verb; the extra possessive marker is not used here. [rule: none]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 病人：生病，“病人” is a noun meaning “patient,” while this position needs a verb meaning “become ill.” [rule: word_class_misuse]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 特别是毒：特别有毒，“毒” cannot be used as an adjective after an intensifier such as “特别”; “有毒” is the correct adjective phrase. [teacher rule: du_youdu]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个植物对药：一种能做药的植物，“对药” is not a valid way to describe a plant’s medical use; “能做药的” correctly describes a kind of plant that can be used as medicine. [rule: none]
7. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 可以吃对药：可以吃、能做药，“对药” cannot express either “edible” or “usable as medicine”; these two predicates correctly describe the plant. [rule: none]
8. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 放在茶里，对药：放在茶里，做成药，“对药” is not a verb phrase; “做成药” expresses making the flower into medicine. [rule: none]
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农先看到很多病人：一个叫神农的人先看到很多病人，This is the first mention of this character, so introduce him with a full noun phrase rather than only a name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
10. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 这个植物可能特别有毒：这些植物可能特别有毒，The earlier sentence refers to many plants and does not identify one specific plant, so the singular reference is unclear. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
11. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他们可以吃、能做药：人们可以吃、能做药，The pronoun could refer either to the doctors or to the patients; “人们” makes the intended general group clear. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
12. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里：他找到了一把花，想把花放在茶里，After the same subject has just been named and no other character intervenes, use zero form instead of repeating the pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]

items.reason: “对药”不能表示“用来做药”，改为“能做药的植物”正确。
“对药”用法错误，改法解决了这个问题，但叙述已完成事件仍应有“了”。
关系从句中“他们”后不应再加多余的“的”。
“病人”是名词，而“让他们”后需要“生病”这样的动词性表达。
“毒”不能直接受“特别”修饰，“特别有毒”正确。
“对药”不能作“植物”的用途描述，“能做药的植物”正确。
“吃对药”不是正确搭配，改后的两个谓语都可成立。
“对药”不能作动词，“做成药”正确表达制药的结果。
神农首次出现时应先作人物介绍，不能只直接使用名字。
前文只提到许多植物，没有明确的单数植物可让“这个植物”指代。
“他们”可指医生或病人，改为“人们”使泛指对象清楚。
两个分句中重复使用近距离指代的“他”是可接受的，并非必须省略。
